# incusos_server (Data Source)

Reads basic IncusOS server environment information from `GET /1.0`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `machine_id` (String)
- `os_name` (String)
- `os_version` (String)
- `os_version_alternate` (String)
- `os_version_next` (String)
- `system_is_ready` (Boolean)
- `uptime` (Number)
